btc_above_200w.note: SMA over completed calendar weeks only

btc_price.note: Yahoo daily close, not a live quote. The page's own live feed is separate.

mstr_price.note: Yahoo daily close, delayed. Not a live quote.

mstr_hidden_bull_div.note: higher swing low with lower RSI(14) at the two lows, swing = lowest low with 5 bars each side, 20-bar pair window, confirmed inside the last 10 bars

bollinger_tight.note: 20-day, 2 sigma, width = (upper - lower) / mid, percentile over trailing 252 days, tight = below 20

realized_vol_rank.note: 20-day realized vol, annualized at 252, percentile over trailing 252 days. A proxy for IV rank, not IV rank.

mstx_price.note: Yahoo daily close, delayed. Not a live quote.

mstr_atm_iv_30d.note: mid of the ATM call and put impliedVolatility Yahoo reports, nearest expiry to 30 days

iv_rank.note: rank = (current - window min) / (window max - window min). The window is the trailing 62 trading days of AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV out of 62 on file. 252 days would make it a 52-week rank.

event.label: FOMC decision day (meeting Sep 15-16, with economic projections)

days_to_next_event.note: hand-maintained calendar. verified=false rows are placeholders, confirm before sizing on them.

iv.source: AlphaQuery option-statistic chart endpoint, keyless, 30-day mean IV. Free tier returns about 63 trading days per call; data/iv-ledger.json accumulates.

reference.note: single source, un-cross-checked. Only the current level is corroborated (AlphaQuery 68.3% the same day).

mstr.note: rank = (current - window min) / (window max - window min). The window is the trailing 62 trading days of AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV out of 62 on file. 252 days would make it a 52-week rank.

mstx.note: rank = (current - window min) / (window max - window min). The window is the trailing 62 trading days of AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV out of 62 on file. 252 days would make it a 52-week rank.

ibit.note: rank = (current - window min) / (window max - window min). The window is the trailing 62 trading days of AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV out of 62 on file. 252 days would make it a 52-week rank.

mstx_mstr_iv_ratio.note: MSTX 30-day IV divided by MSTR 30-day IV, both AlphaQuery. Computed only when the two readings carry the same observation date, null otherwise.

paper_trigger.note: trend trio plus high realized-vol rank; the two PROMISING readings in the 9/12 backtest; nothing is ADOPTED, so the sleeve stays on paper until the 8-week record beats implied odds

sources.prices: Yahoo Finance daily bars via yfinance. Delayed and unofficial.
sources.implied_vol: AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV (keyless chart endpoint) for the MSTR / MSTX / IBIT series and the IV rank; Yahoo's option-chain impliedVolatility field for the single mstr_atm_iv_30d row. Both delayed, neither a computed mid-market vol.
sources.iv_rank: Computed over data/iv-ledger.json, the AlphaQuery entries only, trailing 252 entries at most. Labelled with its window length and called a 52-week window only at a full 252 entries. A ticker whose fetch failed keeps its ledger reading, carries an error string with as_of_fetch null, and sets iv.stale.
sources.events: tools/events.json, hand maintained. Every row carries a verified flag and a source URL.
sources.rule_flags: tools/playbook_rules.json, hand maintained: backtest status plus the adopted flag plus the paper trigger.
sources.rule: No field is ever a fabricated number. A source that fails is written as null with an error string.
